device: iPhone 18 Pro Max / iOS 27.0 simulator (not the build simulator), existing OWNLEVEL Dev app, Hermes + Fabric. NOT a physical iPhone.
source: Real QuickEditor (embedded), QuickController and QuickPinsController with in-memory APIs and storage: 200 saved meals (15 special names with accents, Ñ, digits and a very long one, plus 185 synthetic), no network, no Supabase. Temporary harness (separate Expo Router root on its own Metro: 8101) removed before commit, together with a temporary export of MobileApiContext and the router override; Metro 8081 and the other simulator untouched; simulator appearance and text size restored afterwards (dark, accessibility-large).

findings.title: Duplicate React keys in the letter index
findings.cause: Hermes' Intl.Collator('es', { sensitivity: 'base' }) compares 'N' and 'Ñ' as EQUAL (compare('N','Ñ') === 0 on the simulator), unlike Node's ICU: Ñ words interleaved with N words, sections «Ñ N Ñ», duplicate keys.
findings.fix: initial order is explicit (# A…N Ñ O…Z); the collator only orders names inside one initial; sections are grouped by initial so keys cannot repeat. Native result: # A E G M N Ñ O Z.

findings.title: «Ir a letra» did nothing for letters below the measured rows
findings.cause: scrollToLocation fails (onScrollToIndexFailed: item 85 of 215, 64 measured) and the one retry either lands ~10 rows early or, with sticky section headers, ends at y = 0.
findings.fix: no sticky section headers; several passes 80 ms apart (max 8) that stop when a pass found everything measured and the offset stopped moving, or when the person touches the list. Native result: the letter's header at the top (G, Z).

verifiedNatively.check: scroll position after reviewing a meal and coming back (the library stays mounted with display: none)
verifiedNatively.result: identical: same rows at the same offsets

verifiedNatively.check: search field focus, keyboard and live results
verifiedNatively.result: keyboard opens, layout stable, results update («28 resultados» for «n»)

verifiedNatively.check: native collation of accents, digits and Ñ
verifiedNatively.result: # (3 huevos) < acelga < Ácido < Ají < … < N < Ñ < O

limits: Simulator only: no physical iPhone, no VoiceOver session, no Reduce Motion toggle observed, no real touch latency or memory
The simulator typed only the first character of «noq»; the keyboard result is still valid but longer typing was not observed
